blocks.text: Yeh Unit 3 (Theory of Quadratic Functions) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Sketch and analyse \(y = x^{2} - 2x - 8\): find its intercepts and vertex, say whether the vertex is a maximum or minimum point, and give the intervals where the function increases and decreases. (5 marks)
(\(y = x^{2} - 2x - 8\) ka sketch aur tajziya karein: intercepts aur vertex maloom karein, batayein ke vertex maximum hai ya minimum point, aur woh intervals dein jahan function barhta aur ghatta hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(y\)-intercept, \(x\)-intercepts aur vertex maloom karein; \(a\) ka nishan shakal batata hai.

book_ref.quote: Plot the points and draw a smooth U-shaped curve

steps: \(a = 1 > 0\): parabola upar khulta hai aur \((1, -9)\) minimum point hai
\((-2, 0)\), \((4, 0)\), \((0, -8)\), \((1, -9)\) plot karein aur \(x = 1\) ke gird symmetric hamwar curve banayein
blocks.final_answer: \(y\)-intercept \(-8\); \(x\)-intercepts \(-2, 4\); vertex \((1, -9)\) minimum; \((-\infty, 1)\) par decreasing, \((1, \infty)\) par increasing.

blocks.prompt:
2 Sketch and analyse \(y = -x^{2} + 4x + 5\). (5 marks)
(\(y = -x^{2} + 4x + 5\) ka sketch aur tajziya karein.)
blocks.explanation: Teen khaas points maloom karein; \(a < 0\) ka matlab vertex sab se ooncha point hai.

book_ref.quote: The function changes from increasing to decreasing

steps: \(a = -1 < 0\): parabola neeche khulta hai aur \((2, 9)\) maximum point hai
\((-1, 0)\), \((5, 0)\), \((0, 5)\), \((2, 9)\) plot karein; \(x = 2\) ke gird symmetric hamwar curve banayein
blocks.final_answer: \(y\)-intercept \(5\); \(x\)-intercepts \(-1, 5\); vertex \((2, 9)\) maximum; \((-\infty, 2)\) par increasing, \((2, \infty)\) par decreasing.

blocks.prompt:
3 By completing the square on \(ax^{2} + bx + c\) (\(a \ne 0\)), show that its vertex is \((h, k)\) with \(h = -\frac{b}{2a}\) and \(k = c - \frac{b^{2}}{4a}\). (5 marks)
(\(ax^{2} + bx + c\) (\(a \ne 0\)) par square mukammal kar ke sabit karein ke is ka vertex \((h, k)\) hai jahan \(h = -\frac{b}{2a}\) aur \(k = c - \frac{b^{2}}{4a}\).)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) wale terms se \(a\) bahar nikalein, \(\left(\frac{b}{2a}\right)^{2}\) jama aur tafreeq karein, phir \(a(x - h)^{2} + k\) se muqabla karein.

book_ref.quote: In the middle step we add and subtract

steps: \(a(x - h)^{2} + k\) se muqabla: \(-h = \frac{b}{2a}\), is liye \(h = -\frac{b}{2a}\)
blocks.final_answer: Hence proved (sabit hua): \(ax^{2} + bx + c = a(x - h)^{2} + k\) jahan \(h = -\frac{b}{2a}\), \(k = c - \frac{b^{2}}{4a}\).

blocks.prompt:
4 Find the minimum value of \(f(x) = 2x^{2} + 8x + 3\) by completing the square, and check it with the formulas for \(h\) and \(k\). (5 marks)
(Completing the square se \(f(x) = 2x^{2} + 8x + 3\) ki minimum qeemat maloom karein, aur \(h\) aur \(k\) ke formulas se jaanchein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) wale terms se \(2\) bahar nikalein, square mukammal karein, phir \(h\) aur \(k\) parhein.

book_ref.quote: Take \(a\) out of the \(x^{2}\) and \(x\) terms only

blocks.prompt:
5 Find the maximum value of \(f(x) = -3x^{2} + 6x + 1\) by completing the square, and explain why it is a maximum. (5 marks)
(Completing the square se \(f(x) = -3x^{2} + 6x + 1\) ki maximum qeemat maloom karein, aur wazeh karein ke yeh maximum kyun hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) wale terms se \(-3\) bahar nikalein; bachay hue number ko \(-3\) se zarb dena yaad rakhein.

book_ref.quote: always look at the sign of \(a\) first

blocks.prompt:
6 Find the inverse of \(f(x) = x^{2} - 6x + 5\), \(x \ge 3\). Also find the domain and range of \(f\) and \(f^{-1}\). (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = x^{2} - 6x + 5\), \(x \ge 3\), ka inverse maloom karein. \(f\) aur \(f^{-1}\) ki domain aur range bhi maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) aur \(y\) badlein, quadratic formula se hal karein, aur Range \(f^{-1}\) se nishan chunein.

book_ref.quote: Write \(y = f(x)\) and interchange

blocks.prompt:
7 Find the inverse of \(f(x) = x^{2} + 2x - 3\), \(x \le -1\), with the domain and range of \(f\) and \(f^{-1}\), and verify \(f(f^{-1}(x)) = x\). (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = x^{2} + 2x - 3\), \(x \le -1\), ka inverse \(f\) aur \(f^{-1}\) ki domain aur range ke saath maloom karein, aur \(f(f^{-1}(x)) = x\) ki tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Vertex form istemal karein; baayan baazu \(x \le h\) \(-\) nishan deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Commonly, we restrict the domain to either

steps: \(f(x) = (x + 1)^{2} - 4\); vertex \(h = -1\) par hai, is liye \(x \le -1\) aik baazu hai

blocks.explanation: \(|E| = 3\), \(E = 3\) ya \(E = -3\) mein taqseem hota hai; dono hal karein aur har root jaanchein.

book_ref.quote: If \(d \ge 0\): write \(ax^{2} + bx + c = d\)

blocks.prompt:
9 Solve \(|x^{2} - 6| = x\) and identify the extraneous solutions. (5 marks)
(\(|x^{2} - 6| = x\) hal karein aur extraneous solutions ki nishandahi karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono cases hal karein; chunke right side mein \(x\) hai, har root asal equation mein jaanchein.

book_ref.quote: Sometimes, "extraneous" solutions may appear

blocks.explanation: \(-3 < E < 3\): dono quadratic inequalities critical numbers se hal karein aur intersection lein.

book_ref.quote: two inequalities joined by "and"

blocks.explanation: \(|E| > 5\) ka matlab \(E > 5\) ya \(E < -5\); har aik hal karein aur union lein.

book_ref.quote: the answer is everything in either solution

steps: \(x^{2} - 2x + 2 = (x - 1)^{2} + 1 \ge 1\), kabhi negative nahi: koi hal nahi

blocks.prompt:
12 Solve \(|x^{2} - 9| \le 7\). (5 marks)
(\(|x^{2} - 9| \le 7\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(-7 \le x^{2} - 9 \le 7\): dono hisse hal karein, har region test karein, aur band siray lein.

book_ref.quote: Testing only one region: test every region

steps: (i) \(x^{2} - 2 \ge 0\): critical numbers \(\pm\sqrt{2}\); test \(0\): \(-2 \ge 0\) ghalat; is liye \(x \le -\sqrt{2}\) ya \(x \ge \sqrt{2}\)
(ii) \(x^{2} - 16 \le 0\): critical numbers \(\pm 4\); test \(0\): \(-16 \le 0\) sahi; is liye \(-4 \le x \le 4\)

blocks.prompt:
13 Solve \(x^{4} - 5x^{2} - 36 = 0\) over the real numbers. (5 marks)
(Real numbers par \(x^{4} - 5x^{2} - 36 = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Equation \(x^{2}\) mein quadratic hai: \(y = x^{2}\) rakhein, hal karein, aur \(x\) par wapas aayein.

book_ref.quote: forgetting to go back to \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
14 Solve \(\frac{2}{x - 1} + \frac{3}{x + 1} = 2\), \(x \ne \pm 1\). (5 marks)
(\(\frac{2}{x - 1} + \frac{3}{x + 1} = 2\), \(x \ne \pm 1\), hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har term ko LCD \((x - 1)(x + 1)\) se zarb dein, phir quadratic formula lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Solve (factorisation or the quadratic formula)

blocks.prompt:
15 Solve \(\frac{x}{x - 2} + \frac{4}{x + 2} = \frac{8}{x^{2} - 4}\). (5 marks)
(\(\frac{x}{x - 2} + \frac{4}{x + 2} = \frac{8}{x^{2} - 4}\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Note karein \(x^{2} - 4 = (x - 2)(x + 2)\); fractions khatam karein aur excluded qeemat radd karein.

book_ref.quote: Keeping a root that makes a denominator zero

blocks.prompt:
16 Solve \(\sqrt{2x + 3} + \sqrt{x + 1} = 5\). (5 marks)
(\(\sqrt{2x + 3} + \sqrt{x + 1} = 5\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik radical akela karein, square karein, baqi radical akela karein, dobara square karein, phir dono candidates jaanchein.

book_ref.quote: If a radical remains, isolate it and square again

blocks.prompt:
17 Solve \(\sqrt{3x + 1} = 1 + \sqrt{x + 4}\). (5 marks)
(\(\sqrt{3x + 1} = 1 + \sqrt{x + 4}\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Square karein, baqi radical akela karein, dobara square karein, aur asal equation mein jaanchein.

book_ref.quote: Squaring before isolating the radical

blocks.prompt:
18 The length of a rectangular garden is \(5\) m more than twice its breadth, and its area is \(150\) m\(^{2}\). Find the length and the breadth. (5 marks)
(Aik mustateel bagh ki lambai us ki chaurai ke dugne se \(5\) m zyada hai, aur raqba \(150\) m\(^{2}\) hai. Lambai aur chaurai maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Chaurai \(x\) farz karein; lambai \(2x + 5\) hogi. Raqba \(=\) lambai \(\times\) chaurai istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: Keeping a negative length or breadth as an answer

steps: Chaurai negative nahi ho sakti, is liye \(x = \frac{15}{2} = 7.5\)

blocks.prompt:
19 A workshop's weekly profit (in thousands of rupees) is \(P(x) = -x^{2} + 12x - 20\), where \(x\) is the number of chairs made (in tens). Find the production levels that give a profit of at least \(12\) thousand rupees, and the maximum profit. (5 marks)
(Aik workshop ka hafta-waar munafa (hazaar rupay mein) \(P(x) = -x^{2} + 12x - 20\) hai, jahan \(x\) banayi gayi kursiyan (dahaiyon mein) hain. Woh production levels maloom karein jin par munafa kam az kam \(12\) hazaar rupay ho, aur zyada se zyada munafa bhi.)
blocks.explanation: \"At least\" ka matlab \(\ge\); quadratic inequality hal karein, phir maximum ke liye square mukammal karein.

book_ref.quote: Translate the conditions into an equation or inequality

steps: Is liye \(4 \le x \le 8\), yani \(40\) se \(80\) kursiyan
Zyada se zyada munafa \(16\) hazaar rupay, \(x = 6\) par (\(60\) kursiyan)
blocks.final_answer: Munafa \(4 \le x \le 8\) (\(40\) se \(80\) kursiyan) par kam az kam \(12\) hazaar rupay hai; zyada se zyada munafa \(60\) kursiyon par \(16\) hazaar rupay hai.

blocks.prompt:
20 A ball is thrown upward from a roof; its height after \(t\) seconds is \(h(t) = -5t^{2} + 25t + 10\) metres. Find the maximum height, the time at which it is reached, and when the ball is again at the height of the roof. (5 marks)
(Aik gend chhat se upar phenki jati hai; \(t\) seconds baad is ki unchai \(h(t) = -5t^{2} + 25t + 10\) metre hai. Zyada se zyada unchai, us ka waqt, aur gend dobara chhat ki unchai par kab hogi, maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Maximum ke liye square mukammal karein; chhat ki unchai \(h(0)\) hai.

book_ref.quote: Answer in words with units and check against the question

steps: Zyada se zyada unchai \(\frac{165}{4} = 41.25\) m, \(t = \frac{5}{2} = 2.5\) s par
\(t = 0\) shuru hai, is liye gend \(t = 5\) s par dobara chhat ki unchai par hogi
blocks.final_answer: Zyada se zyada unchai \(41.25\) m, \(t = 2.5\) s par; \(t = 5\) s par dobara chhat ki unchai (\(10\) m) par.

blocks.prompt:
21 The sum of the squares of two consecutive positive odd numbers is \(202\). Find the numbers. (5 marks)
(Do musalsal positive taaq (odd) numbers ke squares ka majmua \(202\) hai. Numbers maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Numbers \(n\) aur \(n + 2\) farz karein; quadratic equation banayein aur positive taaq qeemat rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Suppose the unknown quantities to be

steps: Numbers positive hain, is liye \(n = 9\); agla taaq number \(11\) hai
